verdict.rationale: Inngest ships a first-party testing library that mocks function state, step tooling and inputs through a Jest-compatible API (inngest-docs-14). Community users praise a local development server or local mode that makes debugging jobs easy (inngest-comm-7, inngest-comm-9), and the engine can be self-hosted (inngest-docs-9, inngest-gh-1). However, the evidence never shows a single command that starts the whole engine locally, and it never mentions time skipping for sleeps or waits in tests. missing for 10: documented one-command local engine startup, time-skipping test utilities, hands-on corroboration of the testing library.
